name: Watergate
description: A real conspiracy from break-in to cover-up, run from the White House and proven by tapes, testimony, and journalism — forcing Nixon's resignation. The permanent rejoinder to 'a conspiracy that big couldn't stay secret': it didn't.

name: Gulf of Tonkin Incident
description: The reported 4 August attack on US destroyers — used to pass the resolution escalating the Vietnam War — did not happen as described: NSA historical analysis released in 2005 concluded no attack occurred that night and intelligence was skewed. A documented case of a war justified partly on a phantom event.

name: Operation Northwoods Proposal
description: Joint Chiefs of Staff memoranda proposing false-flag operations — staged attacks to be blamed on Cuba as pretext for invasion — rejected by Kennedy and declassified in 1997. The standing proof that false-flag *proposals* reached the highest levels, routinely cited far beyond what the documents show was ever done.

name: Media, PA FBI Burglary
description: Activists broke into an FBI field office and mailed the files to newspapers, revealing COINTELPRO. The burglars stayed anonymous until 2014. A pivotal demonstration that document exfiltration, not speculation, is how real conspiracies surface.
